---
title: "AV Blocking Incidents in San Francisco"
subtitle: "Frequency, hazard classification, and risk-matrix placement of robotaxi blocking events"
---

When an autonomous vehicle (AV) becomes immobilized in a travel lane, intersection, transit
lane, or emergency scene, it can obstruct traffic and first responders until a remote
operator or a field technician recovers it. This project analyzes the San Francisco
Department of Emergency Management (DEM) log of such **AV blocking incidents** for 2025.
